title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Protocol Error Close Architecture
purpose: Define the accepted WebSocket tunnel helper boundary for converting malformed WebSocket frame parser failures into protocol-error close frames.
design_summary: `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext.ReadMessageOrCloseOnProtocolErrorAsync` wraps the existing parser-backed `ReadMessageAsync` path. If the parser raises an HTTP/3 `MESSAGE_ERROR` for malformed WebSocket bytes, the helper writes a valid unmasked close frame with status code 1002, completes the writable side of the stream, and then rethrows the parser failure so the handler can account for the protocol error.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper reuses the per-tunnel parser state and close-frame writer. It does not consume or suppress non-WebSocket HTTP/3 errors, and it does not introduce connection-level state or automatic exception policy.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Only parser failures surfaced as `Http3ErrorCode.MessageError` are converted to a WebSocket protocol-error close frame.
The parser failure is rethrown after the close frame is written.
The helper is opt-in for application handlers and does not change the default `ReadMessageAsync` behavior.
risks: Application callers can overread this helper as full exception-to-close-code mapping if the opt-in boundary is not kept explicit.
Live external WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remains future work.
